title: Santa Clauses and a Soccer Championship
titleZh: 圣诞老人和足球锦标赛
statementMd:
The country Treeland consists of $*n*$ cities connected with $*n* - 1$ bidirectional roads in such a way that it's possible to reach every city starting from any other city using these roads. There will be a soccer championship next year, and all participants are Santa Clauses. There are exactly $2*k*$ teams from $2*k*$ different cities.

During the first stage all teams are divided into $*k*$ pairs. Teams of each pair play two games against each other: one in the hometown of the first team, and the other in the hometown of the other team. Thus, each of the $2*k*$ cities holds exactly one soccer game. However, it's not decided yet how to divide teams into pairs.

It's also necessary to choose several cities to settle players in. Organizers tend to use **as few cities as possible** to settle the teams.

Nobody wants to travel too much during the championship, so if a team plays in cities $*u*$ and $*v*$, it wants to live in one of the cities on the shortest path between $*u*$ and $*v*$ (maybe, in $*u*$ or in $*v*$). There is another constraint also: the teams from one pair must live in the same city.

Summarizing, the organizers want to divide $2*k*$ teams into pairs and settle them in the minimum possible number of cities $*m*$ in such a way that teams from each pair live in the same city which lies between their hometowns.

## Input

The first line of input contains two integers $*n*$ and $*k*$ ($2 ≤ *n* ≤ 2·10^{5}, 2 ≤ 2*k* ≤ *n*$) — the number of cities in Treeland and the number of pairs of teams, respectively.

The following $*n* - 1$ lines describe roads in Treeland: each of these lines contains two integers $*a*$ and $*b*$ ($1 ≤ *a*, *b* ≤ *n*, *a* ≠ *b*$) which mean that there is a road between cities $*a*$ and $*b*$. It's guaranteed that there is a path between any two cities.

The last line contains $2*k*$ distinct integers $*c*_{1}, *c*_{2}, ..., *c*_{2*k*}$ ($1 ≤ *c*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$), where $*c*_{*i*}$ is the hometown of the $*i*$-th team. All these numbers are distinct.

## Output

The first line of output must contain the only positive integer $*m*$ which should be equal to the minimum possible number of cities the teams can be settled in.

The second line should contain $*m*$ distinct numbers $*d*_{1}, *d*_{2}, ..., *d*_{*m*}$ ($1 ≤ *d*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$) denoting the indices of the cities where the teams should be settled.

The $*k*$ lines should follow, the $*j*$-th of them should contain $3$ integers $*u*_{*j*}$, $*v*_{*j*}$ and $*x*_{*j*}$, where $*u*_{*j*}$ and $*v*_{*j*}$ are the hometowns of the $*j*$-th pair's teams, and $*x*_{*j*}$ is the city they should live in during the tournament. Each of the numbers $*c*_{1}, *c*_{2}, ..., *c*_{2*k*}$ should occur in all $*u*_{*j*}$'s and $*v*_{*j*}$'s exactly once. Each of the numbers $*x*_{*j*}$ should belong to ${*d*_{1}, *d*_{2}, ..., *d*_{*m*}}$.

If there are several possible answers, print any of them.

## Note

In the first test the orginizers can settle all the teams in the city number $2$. The way to divide all teams into pairs is not important, since all requirements are satisfied anyway, because the city $2$ lies on the shortest path between every two cities from ${2, 4, 5, 6}$.
statementZhMd:
特里兰由 $*n*$ 座城市组成，这些城市之间由 $*n* - 1$ 条双向道路连接，并且从任意一座城市出发，都可以通过这些道路到达其他任意城市。明年将举行一届足球锦标赛，所有参赛者都是圣诞老人。恰好有来自 $2*k*$ 个不同城市的 $2*k*$ 支球队。

在第一阶段，所有球队将被分成 $*k*$ 对。每对球队进行两场比赛：一场在其中一支球队的主场进行，另一场在另一支球队的主场进行。因此，这 $2*k*$ 座城市中的每座城市恰好承办一场足球比赛。然而，目前还没有决定如何将球队分成若干对。

还需要选择若干座城市来安置球员。组织者希望使用尽可能少的城市来安置球队。

没有人希望在锦标赛期间长途奔波，因此，如果一支球队要在城市 $*u*$ 和 $*v*$ 进行比赛，那么它希望居住在 $*u*$ 和 $*v*$ 之间最短路径上的某座城市中（也可以是 $*u*$ 或 $*v*$）。此外还有一个限制：同一对中的两支球队必须居住在同一座城市。

综上所述，组织者希望将 $2*k*$ 支球队分成若干对，并将它们安置在尽可能少的城市 $*m*$ 中，使得每一对球队居住在同一座位于它们主场之间的城市中。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含两个整数 $*n*$ 和 $*k*$（$2 ≤ *n* ≤ 2·10^{5}, 2 ≤ 2*k* ≤ *n*$）——特里兰的城市数量以及球队对的数量。

接下来的 $*n* - 1$ 行描述特里兰的道路：每行包含两个整数 $*a*$ 和 $*b*$（$1 ≤ *a*, *b* ≤ *n*$，$*a* ≠ *b*$），表示城市 $*a*$ 和城市 $*b*$ 之间有一条道路。保证任意两个城市之间都存在路径。

最后一行包含 $2*k*$ 个互不相同的整数 $*c*_{1}, *c*_{2}, ..., *c*_{2*k*}$（$1 ≤ *c*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$），其中 $*c*_{*i*}$ 是第 $*i*$ 支球队的主场城市。所有这些数字均互不相同。

## 输出格式

输出的第一行必须包含唯一的正整数 $*m*$，它应等于可以安置球队的城市数量的最小值。

第二行应包含 $*m*$ 个互不相同的整数 $*d*_{1}, *d*_{2}, ..., *d*_{*m*}$（$1 ≤ *d*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$），表示球队应被安置的城市编号。

接下来输出 $*k*$ 行，第 $*j*$ 行应包含 $3$ 个整数 $*u*_{*j}$、$*v*_{*j}$ 和 $*x*_{*j}$，其中 $*u*_{*j}$ 和 $*v*_{*j}$ 是第 $*j*$ 对球队的主场城市，$*x*_{*j}$ 是锦标赛期间它们应居住的城市。每个数 $*c*_{1}, *c*_{2}, ..., *c*_{2*k*}$ 都必须在所有 $*u*_{*j}$ 和 $*v*_{*j}$ 中恰好出现一次。每个数 $*x*_{*j}$ 都必须属于 ${*d*_{1}, *d*_{2}, ..., *d*_{*m*}}$。

如果有多种可行答案，输出任意一种即可。

## 说明

在第一个测试中，组织者可以将所有球队安置在编号为 $2$ 的城市中。如何将所有球队分成若干对并不重要，因为无论怎样分组都满足所有要求：城市 $2$ 位于 ${2, 4, 5, 6}$ 中任意两座城市之间的最短路径上。
